{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Black|more=Market}}
[[File:Black_Market.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Beings dealing on the black market]]
{{Quote|But thanks to recent events and my appalling lack of good judgment, my time with the Rebellion has earned me a death mark on all Imperial worlds. Including the ''good'' ones ― Corellia, Coruscant, Eriadu, Thyferra... You know, the ones with ''thriving black markets''.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[0 ABY/Legends|two months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]|<ref name="SW1">[[Star Wars (2013) 1|''Star Wars'' (2013) 1]]</ref>}}
The '''black market''', also called the '''underground market''',<ref name="Corellia Antilles">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref> was an illegal means of dealing goods and services, outside of the eyes of the government where goods not publicly sold or traded could be found and purchased. Virtually every [[Planet/Legends|planet]] had a black market of some kind.<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> Many forbidden [[Droid/Legends|droids]], drugs, weapons, and other technological innovations could be found on the black market, as well as banned [[Music/Legends|music]] and entertainment, bootleg [[Hologram/Legends|holos]] and [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Gender/Legends|girls]]. On repressive or religious planets, items like [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]] or [[Caffeine/Legends|caffeine]] would be available only through the black market.<ref name="GG6" />

Even planets allied to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] were known to have black markets containing [[Pornography|pornographic]] holos, alcohol, or expensive [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] not carried in the [[Alliance Commissary]].<ref name="GG6" />

Black-market technology was often employed by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and other criminal organizations such as the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]]. Although the technology was effective, it was sometimes outdated. Also, the users would have to be careful, as it was a crime to possess illegal items.

Items were usually classified in three categories:<ref name="GG6" />
*F (Fee) - A special fee or permit was usually required to purchase these items. The fee ran from 5 to 50 percent of cost of the item and averaged 10 percent. Records of these transactions were kept to track who owned such items. The black market would prevent the names of the purchasers from getting into such records. This was helpful for acquiring items that would go to the Rebellion. In addition to the above mentioned, [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and [[Hunting blaster/Legends|hunting blasters]] were included with this group, but required a fee and permit on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-dominated worlds.
*R (Restricted) - These items were only accessible with a local or Imperial license, involving a background check and high fee (100 percent of the item's cost or higher). The background check and fees could be avoided with the black market. Items included most combat weapons, [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]], [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]], [[Starship/Legends|ship]]-mounted weapons, and [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]].
*X (Illegal) - Possession may have violated local law, Imperial law, or both. These items would only be available through the black market. Items included [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]], [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]], [[Spice/Legends|spice]], and anti-Imperial holos.

Planets such as [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] and [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] all had thriving black markets.<ref name="SW1" />

Goods did not necessarily have to be illegal or restricted to be sold on the black market, as some vendors would try to avoid taxes or notifying authorities.<ref name="GG6" />

Certain goods that were normally not mass produced and not available for sale, such as [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], could end up being sold and bought on the black market. An example was [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano's]] stolen [[Ahsoka Tano's lightsabers/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="TCW">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref>

==Examples of black markets==
The [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]] was considered the biggest black market in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. It had been built by five crime syndicates wanting a neutral meeting ground to deal, and later offered to any parties with similar needs.<ref name="CP">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Clouded Paths}}</ref> The [[A68 Market]] was a black market right under the nose of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], located within the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="DSTC">''[[Death Star Technical Companion]]''</ref>
